reviews.title: Solid Budget Cooler for Gamers & Creators
reviews.comment: The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/G1HzKtY857L.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/61gCI9o4yXL._SY256.jpg As a tech YouTuber, @DevonDoesTech if you want to find me! I’m always on the lookout for budget-friendly PC parts, and the Thermalright Assassin Spirit 120 EVO delivers. It keeps my CPU nice and cool, even during long gaming sessions and video editing. The ARGB fan looks great and isn’t too loud, which is a big plus. Installation was pretty straightforward, just make sure your case has enough clearance. If you need an affordable air cooler that actually works, this one’s a no-brainer!
reviews.author: DevonDoesTech

reviews.title: Thermalright doing what they do best.
reviews.comment: Does exactly what it needs to, used this in a buddy's build. Cools great while looking great while doing it. Very impressive they packed such great performance into such a compact cooler, all while not being too noisy. Comes with all the mounting hardware you'd need for any Socket design from the last multiple intel generations, as well as both AM4 and AM5, also comes with termal paste and was very easy to install. A much needed upgrade in cooling over stock, while suppling better airflow on a budget.
reviews.author: Tyler

reviews.title: Solid cheaper cooler from a great company
reviews.comment: Performs as most revirews lead you to believe. amazingly. for the price this is a great cooler. I dont know id throw it in an overclocking situation but thus far its been great on an i5 gaming all the time for my older kid. Super easy to install super easy to get rolling pretty much plug and play. Havent needed any 3rd party apps for it thus far either
reviews.author: steven

reviews.title: Good cooling, good value
reviews.comment: Great look and great cooling. It only has 2 screws for mounting, and I tend to think 4 (one on each corner) would be more ideal, but it's hard to argue with results plus the value.
